I fixed the dropdown getting stuck when the `current` version's path is `/`. The existing tests in `packages/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/src/client` pass (44 of 44). I didn't add a test for this exact setup or check it in a running site.

**Cause:** `getActiveVersion` in `packages/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/src/client/docsClientUtils.ts` works out which version a page belongs to. It checked the latest released version last, because its path (like `/docs`) matches every page under the docs. But in the issue's config, the version with the catch-all path is `current`, not the latest release. Since `current` was checked early, it matched every docs page, so the dropdown always showed "Current".

**Fix:** The function now checks versions in order of path length, longest first, so more specific paths win. The catch-all path is the shortest, so it is always tried last, whichever version owns it. When the latest release owns it, which is the usual setup, the result is the same as before.
